integrity: The covariance is derived from exact edge-set overlap. The inverse is reduced by permutation symmetry to four distance classes and solved from exact Johnson neighbor counts. Sign claims follow from explicit positive factors for every n at least six and every p strictly between zero and one. Exact-rational replay verifies the algebra but does not replace the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns linear least-squares partial correlations, not nonlinear conditional correlations.
The graph is homogeneous Erdős–Rényi with independent edges and n at least six.
Classical Johnson-scheme resolvent formulas may encode the same inverse algebraically; the principal originality risk is an older unnoticed specialization.
title: Alternating precision geometry of triangle indicators in an Erdős–Rényi graph
